rules.name: Valve to assigned pipeline distance
rules.description: Flag a valve geometry farther from its assigned pipeline than the configured tolerance.

rules.name: Duplicate asset identifier
rules.description: Asset identifiers should be unique within an asset layer.

rules.name: Required attribute missing
rules.description: Required operational attributes such as status and pipeline_id should be present.

rules.name: Missing or invalid geometry
rules.description: Operational features require a valid geometry of the declared layer type.

rules.name: Pipeline segment network gap
rules.description: Adjacent segments for a pipeline should meet at the same node coordinate.

rules.name: Invalid asset reference
rules.description: Incident, work, and inspection references must resolve to a known asset.

rules.name: Work order references unknown asset
rules.description: Every work order asset_id should resolve to an asset record.

rules.name: Inspection references unknown asset
rules.description: Every inspection asset_id should resolve to an asset record.

rules.name: Relationship changed between snapshots
rules.description: A changed foreign-key relationship should appear in the snapshot change manifest.
